name: Douga Cinderella
source:
Thirty-year-old Saki is not very good at making eye contact with people when talking to them.
In an attempt to overcome this difficulty, she started talking about becoming a YouTuber...

A slightly different and heartwarming story?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21340]Freem![/url]]
translation:
三十岁的萨基不太擅长与人交谈时进行眼神交流。
为了克服这个困难，她开始谈论成为一名YouTuber……

一个略有不同且温馨的故事？
